name: Olaf
title: the Berserker

Q.name: Undertow
Q.description: Olaf throws an axe, dealing 70/120/170/220/270 + 1×bonus AD physical damage and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% for up to 3 seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose 20% Armor for 4 seconds. If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to (2.5) × ? seconds, or fully refunded if (2.5) × ? seconds has elapsed.
Q.summary: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

W.name: Tough It Out
W.description: Olaf gains 40/50/60/70/80% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, and 10/40/70/100/130 plus 17.5% missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of 10/40/70/100/130 + (0.175 × (1 + (-1 × 0.3)))×max HP Shield below 30% Health) for 2.5 seconds.
W.summary: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

E.name: Reckless Swing
E.description: Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing 70/115/160/205/250 + 0.5×AD true damage. If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded. Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters.
E.summary: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

R.name: Ragnarok
R.description: Passive: Olaf gains 10/15/20 Armor and 10/15/20 Magic Resist. Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for 3 seconds. While active, Olaf gains 10/20/30 + 0.25×AD Attack Damage. Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by 2.5 seconds. Additionally, Olaf gains 20/45/70% Move Speed towards enemy champions for 1 second.
R.summary: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

Passive.name: Berserker Rage
Passive.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.
Passive.summary: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Berserker duelist who throws axes to slow and shred armor, gaining attack speed and lifesteal as his health drops. Wins fights by activating R to cleanse and ignore crowd control while chasing with true-damage E swings.
strengths: R cleanses and grants immunity to immobilizing/disabling effects while he keeps attacking
Q axe slows (longer with distance) and shreds armor; short cooldown if he picks it up
E true damage, cooldown lowered by his attacks
Passive attack speed and lifesteal grow as his health drops: very strong duels
Fast, healthy early clear and invades
weaknesses: No dash: kited once Q slow misses
R does not stop slows: heavy slows still kite him
Falls off late against grouped teams and tanks
Must walk to pick up the axe to keep Q's short cooldown
Only W shield as defence early, weak to burst before R

curve.lvl1: strong – Q axe clear and duels
curve.lvl6: strong – R makes him unstoppable for dives
curve.items: strong – Black Cleaver or Sundered Sky, then Sterak's
curve.late: medium – dive threat, but kited by slows

profile.curveNote: Strong duellist from level 1; R from 6 makes his dives work through crowd control.
profile.sustain: high – passive lifesteal at low health
profile.mobility: low – no dash; R move speed toward enemies

Passive.notes: Attack speed + lifesteal scale with missing health.

Q.notes: Axe throw: slow (longer with distance) + armor shred; pick up to reset cooldown.

W.notes: Attack speed + shield scaling with missing health.

E.notes: True damage swing; attacks lower its cooldown.

R.notes: Cleanses and grants immunity to immobilizing/disabling effects; attacks extend it.

profile.windowAgainst: R down: hard crowd control stops him. Slow and kite him; slows still work during R.
checks: R: confirm slows are not cleansed/blocked (Riot text says immobilizing and disabling effects).
